subject: NovaCore marketplace integration — crawl plan, gating items, and timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2023 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: NovaCore marketplace integration — crawl plan, gating items, and timeline

Team —

Quick summary: NovaCloud (partner) is asking to get Redwood listed in their marketplace as a featured inference provider. They want a short integration so their ISV partners (e.g., Parker Systems) can select Redwood as an offering inside their managed stacks. The ask from Nova is relatively light for initial go-live but they have a few gating items that may require product/legal support.

Primary asks I captured on the call with Sara Navarro today:
- Minimal integration must include: model selection UI hook, redirect to our billing/activation flow, and an entitlement check API.
- Security/compliance note: Nova requires a data-retention statement and audit-log export sample for marketplace listings.
- Timeline: Nova expects a go/no-go decision and an initial staging listing by the end of April (they offered an early May pilot).

Questions for product/infra:
1) Do we have a ready-to-ship entitlement API surface (token + org id) that marketplace consignments can call?
2) Any blocker on producing a 1-page audit-log extract for the last 30 days?
3) Are there obvious risks with exposing model-choice hooks (UI redirect + params) to a marketplace catalog?

I've attached a starter checklist (integration-checklist.xlsx) and our API surface draft (redwood-api-surface-v2.pdf). Please review and flag anything that blocks the April staging target.

I'll organize a 30m sync with Nova next week if we think this is feasible.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: integration-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-api-surface-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2023 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaCore marketplace integration — crawl plan, gating items, and timeline

Marcus —

Thanks for the notes, this aligns with what I expected from the tech call. Quick answers:
- Entitlement API: we have an auth-check endpoint (POST /v1/entitlements/check) but it assumes the caller is an internal Redwood client. We can add a client-key + org-id variant (couple days engineering + one small infra PR for rate limits).
- Audit logs: we can produce a 1-page export of recent events (request ids, model id, user org hash) but it will require throttling redaction for PII. Compliance needs to sign off.
- Model-choice hooks: exposing a redirect is fine, but we should avoid letting marketplace pass arbitrary generation parameters. Suggest whitelist of params (model_id, preset_profile, org_id) and require server-side validation.

Action items I propose:
- E2E tech spike to add marketplace-friendly entitlement endpoint (owner: me) — estimate 3 business days.
- Compliance to approve audit log redact rules (owner: Evelyn).
- Product to define param whitelist and UX in the listing flow (owner: Vanessa).

I can start the entitlement spike Wed/Thu if we agree.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
